questions.prompt: What is USAF pay grade E-1?
questions.explanation: USAF enlisted ranks: E1 Airman Basic, E2 Airman, E3 Airman First Class, E4 Senior Airman, E5 Staff Sergeant, E6 Technical Sergeant, E7 Master Sergeant, E8 Senior Master Sergeant, E9 Chief Master Sergeant.

questions.prompt: What is USAF pay grade E-3?
What is USAF pay grade E-4?
questions.explanation: E-4 in the Air Force is Senior Airman (SrA). In the Space Force, E-4 is Specialist 4.

questions.prompt: What is USAF pay grade E-6?
What is USAF pay grade E-8?
What is USSF pay grade E-1?
questions.explanation: USSF enlisted ranks: E1 Specialist 1, E2 Specialist 2, E3 Specialist 3, E4 Specialist 4, E5 Sergeant, E6 Technical Sergeant, E7 Master Sergeant, E8 Senior Master Sergeant, E9 Chief Master Sergeant, plus the Chief Master Sergeant of the Space Force.

questions.prompt: What is USSF pay grade E-4?
questions.explanation: E-4 in the Space Force is Specialist 4.

questions.prompt: What is USSF pay grade E-5?
questions.explanation: In the Space Force, E-5 is Sergeant. In the Air Force, E-5 is Staff Sergeant.

questions.prompt: Which USSF ranks make up the Specialist tier?
questions.explanation: Specialist tier: Specialist 1 to 4 (E-1 to E-4). NCO tier: Sergeant and Technical Sergeant (E-5, E-6). Senior NCO tier: E-7 to E-9.

questions.explanation: The Chief Master Sergeant of the Space Force (CMSSF) is the senior enlisted Guardian.
